preseason_hypothesis: O'Leary will retain the prior defense's disguise and simulated-pressure foundation while changing call sequencing
confirming_evidence: late safety rotation; varied rushers; pressure without high blitz rate; familiar personnel rules
disconfirming_evidence: static shells; consistently declared rushers; major assignment confusion
review_trigger: each preseason game and first four regular-season games

preseason_hypothesis: Tuipulotu will lead Chargers edge defenders in snaps and pass-rush opportunities
confirming_evidence: starts across base and nickel; leads edge rush snaps; remains on field in high-leverage downs
disconfirming_evidence: Mack or Mesidor leads the rotation; Tuipulotu leaves the field in core pass situations

preseason_hypothesis: Mesidor will immediately operate as the third edge and reduce inside on passing downs
confirming_evidence: first-unit three-edge packages; interior alignment in obvious pass situations; regular pressure opportunities
disconfirming_evidence: reserve-only snaps; little interior use; fourth-edge competition cuts into his role

preseason_hypothesis: Mack's workload will be managed without removing him from high-value pass-rush downs
confirming_evidence: lower early-down share; regular third-down and red-zone rushes; healthy weekly rotation
disconfirming_evidence: full-time workload or substantial loss of money-down snaps

preseason_hypothesis: Tart, Tomlinson, Caldwell, and Eboigbe will rotate across alignments rather than hold fixed jobs
confirming_evidence: multiple alignments by player; package-specific combinations; interior pressure from more than one player
disconfirming_evidence: stable one-position assignments; one pair dominates nearly all snaps

preseason_hypothesis: Henley will retain the green dot and an every-down linebacker role
confirming_evidence: all first-unit packages; two-minute and third-down snaps; communication helmet
disconfirming_evidence: leaves field in dime; another linebacker takes communication or coverage work

preseason_hypothesis: Jackson, Still, and Hart will remain the primary three corners
confirming_evidence: repeat first-unit nickel usage; stable outside/slot assignments; no camp demotion
disconfirming_evidence: Leonard or a young corner displaces one; roles rotate heavily; injury changes the trio

preseason_hypothesis: James will remain a box/slot/pressure movable piece rather than a conventional deep safety
confirming_evidence: box and slot alignments; designed rushes; tight-end and back matchups; high tackle involvement
disconfirming_evidence: majority deep alignment; low rush usage; rookie duties force James away from the ball
review_trigger: each preseason game and first two regular-season games

preseason_hypothesis: Smith will earn nickel-package work that allows James to move toward the line
confirming_evidence: first-unit dime/nickel snaps with Molden; James moves into box; Smith handles deep responsibility
disconfirming_evidence: special-teams-only role; veteran safeties take subpackage snaps; missed tackles or assignments limit trust
